name: Alila Shanghai
insider_take: This ultra-modern sanctuary sits in Shanghai's prestigious Huangpu District, where cutting-edge design meets traditional Chinese hospitality in the heart of China's financial capital.
whats_special: Alila Shanghai stands as an architectural marvel with its striking contemporary facade that illuminates the city skyline. The hotel features innovative wellness spaces including a rooftop infinity pool with panoramic views of the Huangpu River and Pudong's iconic skyscrapers. Each suite showcases floor-to-ceiling windows and locally-inspired design elements that celebrate Shanghai's rich cultural heritage.
pro_tip: Book a river-facing room to witness the spectacular nightly light show that transforms the Bund's historic buildings and Pudong's futuristic towers into a dazzling display of colors.
dont_miss: The hotel's location puts you within walking distance of the legendary Bund waterfront promenade and Yu Garden's 400-year-old traditional architecture. Experience authentic Shanghai cuisine at nearby Michelin-starred restaurants, or take a short stroll to the trendy Xintiandi district for boutique shopping and vibrant nightlife in restored shikumen lane houses.
pros: Contemporary luxury design with modern amenities
Prime location in vibrant Shanghai city center
Award-winning dining experiences with local and international cuisine
cons: Urban location may lack traditional Chinese garden ambiance
